name: omp-autoclassifier
description: Model-backed pre-execution risk classifier for the omp coding agent.

omp.name: omp-autoclassifier
omp.description: Classifies every tool call before it runs and blocks the dangerous ones.

enabled.description: Master switch for the classifier gate.

activeModes.description: Comma-separated approval modes the gate runs in.

escalate.description: On deny, ask interactively instead of blocking outright (interactive sessions only).

classifySubagents.description: Classify tool calls made inside spawned subagents.

stage1TimeoutMs.description: Timeout for the fast filter stage, in milliseconds.

stage2TimeoutMs.description: Timeout for the reasoning stage, in milliseconds.

maxConsecutiveDenials.description: Consecutive denials before the gate pauses itself.

maxTotalDenials.description: Total denials per session before the gate pauses itself.

cacheSize.description: Maximum cached allow verdicts per session.

includeToolResults.description: Include recent tool output as untrusted classifier evidence.

logDecisions.description: Append allow and deny decisions to the JSONL audit log.

logClassifierIo.description: Also log full classifier prompts and responses. May capture secrets.

suggestAlternative.description: Ask the classifier to suggest a safer command when it refuses one. Costs extra tokens per review.

verdictDetail.description: How much of a refusal the notification shows you. The agent always receives full detail.

scripts.verify: bun run check && bun test && bun run test:mutate
